text:
emma-pm: Quick sync: proposing a tenant-shield plan for graceful degradation when regions hit capacity. Goals: predictable UX, VIP opt-outs, minimal flapping.

noah-eng: We should list degradation steps by increasing impact: 1) context trim (shorter prompts), 2) token-rate throttle, 3) model-quant downgrade, 4) regional reroute, 5) serve-best-effort stub.

emma-pm: Agreed. Workflow: detect -> shadow -> throttle -> downgrade -> reroute -> stub. Each step gated by flags and cooldowns.

raj_sre: Safety rules: trigger when region_p95 > baseline + 180ms for 2m AND gpu_util > 85% for 1m. Abort if error_rate > 1.5% for 3m. Record last 100 evicted requests for debug.

olivia-ops: Flag schema (draft):
```
tenant_shield_mode: off|monitor|throttle|downgrade|reroute|stub
tenant_shield_pct: 0-100
tenant_shield_exempt: [tenant_ids]
shield_cooldown_s: 900
max_shields_per_hour: 10
```
Keep flags per-region and allow tenant-level exemption.

maria-sales: Customers ask for "business-hours protection" opt-out. We'll support `tenant_shield_exempt` and `reserved_pool` routing to dedicated capacity; pricing to follow.

emma-pm: Canary plan: shadow only -> 1% traffic (15m) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h). Monitor quality delta (task-specific metric). Halt if degradation threshold breached.

raj_sre: Circuit breakers: max_shields_per_region_hour=6; token-bucket limiter to avoid burst evictions. Add manual panic toggle to runbook.

olivia-ops: Launch checklist: runbook + panic button, dashboards for p95/p99/error-rate/evictions, API to toggle exemptions, customer comms templates.

emma-pm: I'll create the PRD and ping legal/sales for reserved_pool wording. Drop any missing must-haves here.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: `rollout/tenant-shield/v1` -> canary start 2026-04-12T08:00:00Z (1% eu-west)
